title: Kissed Ethiopian Herbal Hash
description: A comforting and aromatic Ethiopian-inspired dish featuring a blend of herbs, served with a crispy exterior and a fluffy interior.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together oregano, thyme, rosemary, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice.
Add the garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Add the mixed mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the herb mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the mushroom mixture in a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the mixture for 1 hour in the sous-vide machine.
Remove the bag from the machine and let it cool slightly.
Using a spatula, break up the mushroom mixture into small pieces and transfer them to a serving plate.
Serve warm, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
